descriptions.en: Fast and foxy, Vulpaphyla are agile allies to bring along on your next adventure.
descriptions.zh: 速度快且狡猾，让狐帕菲拉作为敏捷的友军，和你一起踏上下一次历险。

descriptions.zh: 速度快且狡猾，让狐帕菲拉作为敏捷的友军，和你一起踏上下一次历险。

descriptions.en: These hard-charging, four-legged predators make formidable companions when in the field.
descriptions.zh: 这些强悍的四足捕食者会成为你在战斗时的强大伙伴。

descriptions.en: This sly feline is playful yet devious.
descriptions.zh: 这只狡猾的猫既好玩又诡诈。

descriptions.en: A vicious and deadly Kavat prized for its combat prowess, offering increased critical chance and punishing those that dare attack it.
descriptions.zh: 凶猛而致命的库娃因其战斗力而备受推崇，它能增加暴击几率并惩罚那些胆敢攻击它的人。

descriptions.en: Now free of the Vasca virus, these Kavats can transfuse life to extend not only their own health but that of their master.
descriptions.zh: 现在，这些库娃已经摆脱了噬血病毒，它们可以通过输送生命来延长自己的生命值，同时也可以延长主人的生命值。

descriptions.en: A reliable partner that locates supplies for their Tenno master and while thinning enemy ranks.
descriptions.zh: 一个可靠的伙伴，为他们的 Tenno 主人找到补给并削弱敌人的力量。

descriptions.en: An experimental blending of Kubrow and Infestation. Uses maggots and other Infested abilities to inflict damage and control the battlefield.
descriptions.zh: 库狛与感染者的实验性混合体。可使用蛆虫和其他感染者的能力造成伤害并控制战场。

descriptions.en: A stealthy ally, surprising enemies with impressive takedowns of explosive force.
descriptions.zh: 一个隐秘的伙伴，以惊人的爆炸力量出其不意地击倒敌人。

descriptions.en: A strong guardian focused on protecting its master by bolstering their defense and by driving away attackers.
descriptions.zh: 强大的守护者，专注于通过加强防御和驱赶攻击者来保护其主人。

descriptions.en: Bred by the Orokin for combat. This martial beast lives to create chaos and bring down the most fierce opponents.
descriptions.zh: 由奥罗金培育，用于战斗。这头武术野兽的使命是制造混乱，击倒最凶猛的对手。

descriptions.en: A clever accomplice, trained to relieve the enemy of both their weapons and their loot caches.
descriptions.zh: 一个聪明的伙伴，经过训练可以从敌人手中夺取武器和战利品。
